rules.rule: Every diagnosis code must be a code in the ICD-10-CM edition in effect on the date of service (FY2027 covers October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027).
rules.check: Look the code up in the order file of the edition for the DOS.

rules.title: Report codes to the full number of characters (no categories or subcategories)

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.3
sources.title: 3. Use of codes for reporting purposes

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.F.1
sources.title: 1. ICD-10-CM codes with 3, 4, 5, 6 or 7 characters

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.F.2
sources.title: 2. Use of full number of characters required for a code

rules.rule: Only codes are reportable, not categories or subcategories; a code is invalid if it is not coded to the full number of characters required, including an applicable 7th character.
rules.check: billable flag = 1 in icd10cm_order_<FY>.txt (billable=true in the JSONL).
rules.severity_basis: claim edit rejection or denial expected

rules.title: 7th character required where the Tabular defines one, and must be a defined value

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.5
sources.title: 5. 7th Characters

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, "sevenChrDef" instructional notes
ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.19.a
sources.title: a. Application of 7th Characters in Chapter 19

rules.rule: Codes in categories or subcategories that carry a 7th character definition need a 7th character, and it must be one of the values listed for that category (for example A, D, S for most injuries).
rules.check: Find the longest prefix in icd10cm_seventh_character_<FY>.json; the code must have 7 characters and its 7th must be a key of "chars".

implemented.note: ClaimScrubber names the missing or invalid 7th character, lists the allowed values from icd_7th_2027.tsv.gz and gives a corrected code. The coder still defaults injuries to A (see CH19-INJ-01).

rules.hint: In ClaimScrubber, when isValid/isBillable fails, look up the seventh-character prefix and list the allowed characters (and the X padding) in the issue text.
rules.severity_basis: claim edit rejection or denial expected

rules.title: Placeholder X fills empty positions before a 7th character

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.4
sources.title: 4. Placeholder character

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.5
sources.title: 5. 7th Characters

rules.rule: Where a placeholder exists the X must be used; a code that needs a 7th character but has fewer than 6 characters is padded with X (for example T36.0X1A).
rules.check: If the code is invalid and inserting X up to 6 characters makes it valid, suggest the padded code.

implemented.note: withSeventhCharacter() pads with X to 6 characters; the scrubber suggests the padded code when it is billable.

rules.hint: Add a helper in code_rules.dart that pads with X to 6 characters and re-checks IcdCatalog.isBillable; offer the fix in the scrubber issue.
rules.severity_basis: claim edit rejection or denial expected

rules.title: Excludes1: the two codes are not reported together

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.12.a
sources.title: a. Excludes1

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, "excludes1" instructional notes

rules.rule: An Excludes1 note means the excluded condition is never coded with the code above the note. Exception: when the two conditions are unrelated to each other both may be reported; if unclear, query the provider.
inputs: all diagnosis codes on the claim
rules.check: For each code, collect excludes1 refs at the code and at every ancestor (subcategory, category, block, chapter); flag any other claim code that matches a ref.
rules.severity_basis: coding convention; commercial claim editors deny Excludes1 pairs; allow a documented override for unrelated conditions

implemented.note: Pairwise check over the claim diagnoses using icd10cm_excludes1_2027.tsv.gz (notes at the code and every ancestor, prefix and range refs). Error by default; a diagnosis note saying the conditions are unrelated turns it into a warning (I.A.12.a exception).

rules.hint: Bundle icd10cm_excludes1_<FY>.tsv as an asset, load it in ReferenceData, and add a pairwise check in ClaimScrubber over claim.billable (prefix/range match as in ref_matches).

rules.title: Excludes2: both codes may be reported

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.12.b
sources.title: b. Excludes2

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, "excludes2" instructional notes

rules.rule: An Excludes2 note means the excluded condition is not part of the code, but the patient may have both; both codes may be reported together when appropriate.
rules.check: Never block on an Excludes2 match; at most show it as information.

implemented.note: Nothing to enforce: the scrubber does not block Excludes2 pairs. Keep it that way when Excludes1 checks are added.

rules.severity_basis: guidance

rules.title: Manifestation codes are never first-listed and follow their etiology

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.13
sources.title: 13. Etiology/manifestation convention (“code first”, “use additional code” and “in diseases classified elsewhere” notes)

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, "codeFirst" instructional notes
Definitions of Medicare Code Edits v44.0, edit 6
sources.title: Manifestation code as principal diagnosis

rules.rule: "In diseases classified elsewhere" codes (and other manifestation codes with a "code first" note) are never the first-listed or principal diagnosis; they are listed after the underlying condition.
rules.check: First-listed code must not be in MCE list manifestation_not_principal and must not have "in diseases classified elsewhere" in its title; when such a code is present the etiology code must precede it.

implemented.note: Error when the first-listed code is on the MCE manifestation list or its title says "in diseases classified elsewhere"; warning when the etiology its code-first note names is listed after it (icd_notes_2027.tsv.gz); finalizeDiagnoses moves that etiology ahead.

rules.hint: Remaining: read the codeFirst refs of the manifestation code (icd10cm_code_notes JSONL) and warn when no matching etiology code precedes it.
rules.severity_basis: claim edit rejection or denial expected

rules.title: "Code first" notes: sequence the underlying condition first when present

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.13
sources.title: 13. Etiology/manifestation convention (“code first”, “use additional code” and “in diseases classified elsewhere” notes)

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.7
sources.title: 7. Multiple coding for a single condition

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, "codeFirst" instructional notes

rules.rule: When a code has a "code first" note and the underlying condition is present, the underlying condition is sequenced first. "Code, if applicable, any causal condition first" allows the code first-listed only when the cause is unknown or not applicable.
rules.check: If a codeFirst ref matches another claim code that is listed later, warn and offer to reorder.

implemented.note: KnowledgeChecks.codeFirstIssues warns when a code named in a code-first note is listed after the code; ClinicalCoder.finalizeDiagnoses reorders (a physician-pinned primary stays first). Lines qualified with a character ("with .42") are not used.

rules.hint: Use refs.codeFirst from the JSONL (asset or generated Dart map) in finalizeDiagnoses ordering.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: "Use additional code" notes: add the secondary code when known

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.7
sources.title: 7. Multiple coding for a single condition

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.13
sources.title: 13. Etiology/manifestation convention (“code first”, “use additional code” and “in diseases classified elsewhere” notes)

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, "useAdditionalCode" instructional notes

rules.rule: A "use additional code" note indicates that a secondary code should be added, if known, to fully describe the condition (for example the organism B95-B97 for an infection, Z79.4 for insulin use).
rules.check: If a code (or its ancestors) has useAdditionalCode refs and no claim code matches them, suggest them for review.

implemented.note: Info suggestion per code when no claim code satisfies a category- or code-level use-additional-code note group; never auto-added. The notes are also shown in the claim tab.

rules.hint: Show as a suggestion chip in claim_tab.dart; never auto-add without documentation.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: "Code also" notes: a second code may be needed, sequencing is discretionary

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.17
sources.title: 17. “Code also” note

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, "codeAlso" instructional notes

rules.rule: A "code also" note says two codes may be needed to fully describe a condition; it does not set the order.
rules.check: Informational prompt only.

implemented.note: Info prompt when no claim code satisfies a code-also note.

rules.hint: Suggestion only.
rules.severity_basis: guidance

rules.title: Signs and symptoms integral to a confirmed diagnosis are not coded

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.5
sources.title: 5. Conditions that are an integral part of a disease process

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.18.b
sources.title: b. Use of a symptom code with a definitive diagnosis code

rules.rule: Signs and symptoms routinely associated with a disease process are not assigned as additional codes unless the classification instructs otherwise. Symptoms not routinely associated may be coded.
rules.check: Drop Chapter 18 symptom codes that are routinely part of a confirmed diagnosis; definitive diagnosis is sequenced before any symptom code.

implemented.note: ClinicalCoder folds a symptom into a confirmed diagnosis when an Excludes1 note of the diagnosis names the symptom, plus the body-system heuristic; the scrubber flags hand-entered pairs through Excludes1 and ICD-SYMPTOM-02.

rules.hint: Keep the heuristic but also check Excludes1 notes of the confirmed code that point at the symptom.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: Symptom codes when no definitive diagnosis is established

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.4
sources.title: 4. Signs and symptoms

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.D
sources.title: D. Codes that describe symptoms and signs

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section II.A
sources.title: A. Codes for symptoms, signs, and ill-defined conditions

rules.rule: Symptom and sign codes are acceptable when a related definitive diagnosis has not been established. They are not the principal/first-listed diagnosis when a related definitive diagnosis has been established.
rules.check: Warn when the first-listed code is in Chapter 18 (R00-R99) and a related confirmed diagnosis is also on the claim.

implemented.note: Warning when an R00-R99 code is first-listed and a confirmed diagnosis of the same body system is on the claim.

rules.hint: Promote the scrubber info to a warning when dx.first is R00-R99 and a confirmed diagnosis is present.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: Use a combination code when one code captures all elements

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.9
sources.title: 9. Combination Code

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.18.c
sources.title: c. Combination codes that include symptoms

rules.rule: When a combination code fully identifies the conditions (two diagnoses, a diagnosis with its manifestation, or with a complication), assign only the combination code; add a secondary code only when the combination code lacks needed specificity.
rules.check: Flag pairs that a combination code covers (Index "with" subterms, Excludes1 notes and inclusion terms of the combination code).

implemented.note: Alphabetic Index "with" subterms and "acute and chronic" entries give the combination code: warning in the scrubber; ClinicalCoder.combineFromIndex replaces confirmed pairs (keeps the second code when the combination code asks for it). Excludes1 pairs are errors (ICD-EXCL1-01).

rules.hint: Derive candidate pairs from Excludes1 notes of combination codes rather than hard-coded families.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: Acute and chronic forms: code both, acute first

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.8
sources.title: 8. Acute and Chronic Conditions

rules.rule: If the same condition is described as both acute (subacute) and chronic and separate Index subentries exist at the same level, code both and sequence the acute code first.
rules.check: Requires Index data; warn when both forms are present in the wrong order.

implemented.note: Index subentries acute and chronic under the same term: warning when the chronic code is listed first; a combination entry becomes ICD-COMBO-01.

rules.hint: Use IcdIndex paths containing "acute" and "chronic" under the same main term.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: Sequela: condition first, sequela code second

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.10
sources.title: 10. Sequela (Late Effects)

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.19.a
sources.title: a. Application of 7th Characters in Chapter 19

rules.rule: Coding a sequela generally needs two codes: the residual condition first, then the sequela code (7th character S for injuries). The acute-phase code is never used with a code for the late effect.
rules.check: If a code with 7th character S is first-listed, or no residual condition code accompanies it, warn.

implemented.note: Warning when a 7th character S (sequela) code is first-listed or has no residual condition code.

rules.hint: In ClaimScrubber detect 7th character S on injury/poisoning codes (chapter 19) and check position.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: Report each code only once per encounter

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.12
sources.title: 12. Reporting Same Diagnosis Code More than Once

sources.citation: Definitions of Medicare Code Edits v44.0, edit 3
sources.title: Duplicate of PDX

rules.rule: Each unique ICD-10-CM code may be reported only once for an encounter, including bilateral conditions without distinct laterality codes.
rules.check: No duplicate codes in the diagnosis list.

implemented.note: Error in the scrubber; the claim tab also prevents adding a duplicate.

rules.hint: One-line check in ClaimScrubber: dx.map(code).toSet().length != dx.length.
rules.severity_basis: claim edit rejection or denial expected

rules.title: Laterality and bilateral codes

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.13
sources.title: 13. Laterality

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.13.a
sources.title: a. Site and laterality

rules.rule: If no bilateral code exists and the condition is bilateral, assign separate left and right codes; when a bilateral code exists use it. Laterality may be taken from other clinicians; unspecified side codes should rarely be used.
rules.check: Warn when right and left codes of the same family are both on the claim and a bilateral code exists in that family.

implemented.note: Warning when right and left codes of the same condition are reported and the category has a bilateral code.

rules.hint: Use IcdCatalog.billableChildren on the shared parent to find a "bilateral" sibling.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: Unspecified side when a sided code exists (MCE unspecified code edit)

sources.citation: Definitions of Medicare Code Edits v44.0, edit 20
sources.title: Unspecified code

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.13
sources.title: 13. Laterality

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.18
sources.title: 18. Use of Sign/Symptom/Unspecified Codes

rules.rule: MCE edit 20 lists unspecified codes for which a more specific code identifies laterality. Unspecified side codes are acceptable only when documentation is insufficient.
rules.check: Warn when a code is in MCE list unspecified_with_laterality_available.
rules.severity_basis: payer specificity edits; MCE edit 20 is informational for inpatient

implemented.note: Warning for every code on the MCE v44 edit 20 list (3,476 codes in mce_v44.tsv.gz).

rules.hint: Replace isUnspecifiedIcd with the official 3,476-code MCE list.

rules.title: Codes that are only reported as secondary diagnoses

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.14
sources.title: 14. Documentation by Clinicians Other than the Patient's Provider

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.21.c.17
sources.title: 17) Social Determinants of Health

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.18.e.1
sources.title: 1) Coma Scale

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.18.i
sources.title: i. NIHSS Stroke Scale

rules.rule: BMI, coma scale, NIHSS, blood alcohol level, social determinants of health and underimmunization status codes are reported only as secondary diagnoses, and the associated condition must be documented by the patient's provider.
rules.check: First-listed code must not match the resolved code list in "official_list".

implemented.note: Const prefix list in code_rules.dart; error in ClaimScrubber.sequencingIssues; finalizeDiagnoses ranks them last.

rules.hint: Add a const prefix list to code_rules.dart (generated from official_list) and an error in ClaimScrubber when dx.first matches.

rules.title: Unspecified codes are allowed when documentation lacks detail

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.A.9.b
sources.title: b. “Unspecified” codes

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.B.18
sources.title: 18. Use of Sign/Symptom/Unspecified Codes

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.F.3
sources.title: 3. Highest level of specificity

rules.rule: Code to the highest specificity the documentation supports; signs, symptoms and unspecified codes are acceptable when the record does not provide more detail.
rules.check: Information prompt to document specificity.
rules.severity_basis: guidance

rules.title: Outpatient: do not code uncertain diagnoses

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.H
sources.title: H. Uncertain diagnosis

rules.rule: In the outpatient setting do not code diagnoses documented as probable, suspected, questionable, rule out, compatible with, consistent with, working diagnosis or similar; code the signs, symptoms or other reasons for the visit instead.
rules.check: Uncertain diagnoses are not billed on outpatient/professional claims.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation (overcoding; audit and recoupment risk)

rules.title: Inpatient: uncertain diagnoses at discharge are coded as if established

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section II.H
sources.title: H. Uncertain Diagnosis

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section III.C
sources.title: C. Uncertain Diagnosis

rules.rule: For inpatient admissions (short-term, acute, long-term care and psychiatric hospitals), a diagnosis documented as uncertain at discharge is coded as if it existed. This does not apply to outpatients.
rules.check: Apply only for inpatient place of service.
rules.severity_basis: guidance

rules.title: Outpatient first-listed diagnosis is the reason chiefly responsible for the visit

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.A
sources.title: A. Selection of first-listed condition

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.G
sources.title: G. ICD-10-CM code for the diagnosis, condition, problem, or other reason for encounter/visit

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.J
sources.title: J. Code all documented conditions that coexist

rules.rule: List first the code for the condition chiefly responsible for the services; list additional codes for coexisting conditions that affect care. Do not code conditions previously treated that no longer exist.
rules.check: Review ordering; history codes Z80-Z87 only as secondary information.

implemented.note: finalizeDiagnoses ranking with a physician-pinned primary; warning when a Z80-Z87 history code is first-listed.

rules.hint: Keep the finalizeDiagnoses ranking; let the physician pin the first-listed code (pinnedOrder exists).
rules.severity_basis: guidance

rules.title: External cause codes are never first-listed

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.20.a.6
sources.title: 6) External cause code can never be a principal diagnosis

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.B
sources.title: B. Codes from A00.0 through T88.9, Z00-Z99, U00-U85

sources.citation: Definitions of Medicare Code Edits v44.0, edit 2
sources.title: External causes of morbidity codes as principal diagnosis

rules.rule: External cause of morbidity codes (V00-Y99) are never the principal or first-listed diagnosis; the first-listed code comes from A00.0-T88.9, Z00-Z99 or U00-U85.
rules.check: Error when dx.first starts with V, W, X or Y.

implemented.note: Error in ClaimScrubber.sequencingIssues; finalizeDiagnoses ranks V00-Y99 codes last.

rules.hint: Two lines in ClaimScrubber: if dx.first.code starts with V/W/X/Y raise an error and offer to reorder.
rules.severity_basis: claim edit rejection or denial expected

rules.title: Place of occurrence (Y92) and external cause status (Y99) are reported once

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.20.b
sources.title: b. Place of Occurrence Guideline

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.20.k
sources.title: k. External Cause Status

rules.rule: Y92 and Y99 are secondary codes used with other external cause codes, generally only at the initial encounter; only one Y99 per record; do not use Y92.9 or Y99.9 when not stated; Y99 is not used for poisonings, adverse effects, misadventures or late effects.
rules.check: Warn on more than one Y99, Y92.9/Y99.9, or Y92/Y99 without another external cause code.

implemented.note: Warnings on more than one Y99 or Y92, on Y92.9/Y99.9, and on Y92/Y99 without another external cause code.

rules.hint: Count Y92/Y99 codes in ClaimScrubber; warn on duplicates and on Y92.9/Y99.9.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: Outpatient diagnostic services: code the interpreted result

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.K
sources.title: K. Patients receiving diagnostic services only

rules.rule: For diagnostic services only, sequence first the reason for the test; when a physician has interpreted the test and the report is available, code confirmed diagnoses from the interpretation and not the related signs and symptoms.
rules.check: Workflow rule.

implemented.note: Info reminder when a diagnostic test (PFS PC/TC indicator 1, 2, 4, 6 or 8) is billed with a symptom first-listed.

rules.hint: Workflow hint in the encounter screen when a test interpretation is signed.
rules.severity_basis: guidance

rules.title: Preoperative evaluation: Z01.81- first

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.M
sources.title: M. Patients receiving preoperative evaluations only

rules.rule: For preoperative evaluations only, sequence first a code from Z01.81-, then the reason for surgery and any findings.
rules.check: Warn when a pre-op visit is not led by Z01.81-.

implemented.note: ClinicalCoder adds Z01.810/Z01.811/Z01.818 for a documented preoperative evaluation and ranks it first; error when Z01.81- is not first.

rules.hint: When the visit reason is pre-op, prepend Z01.81- in ClinicalCoder.finalizeDiagnoses.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: Encounter for chemotherapy, immunotherapy or radiation therapy: Z51.- first

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section IV.L
sources.title: L. Patients receiving therapeutic services only

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.2.a
sources.title: a. Admission/Encounter for treatment of primary site

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.2.e.2
sources.title: 2) Patient admission/encounter chiefly for administration of antineoplastic chemotherapy, immunotherapy and radiation therapy

rules.rule: When the encounter is chiefly for antineoplastic chemotherapy, immunotherapy or radiation therapy, the Z51.0 / Z51.1- code is listed first and the malignancy second.
rules.check: Warn when chemo/radiation administration services are billed and Z51.0/Z51.1- is not first.

implemented.note: Warning when chemotherapy administration (96401-96549) or radiation treatment delivery (77401-77525) is billed and Z51.0/Z51.1- is not first.

rules.hint: When chemo/radiation administration lines are billed, require Z51.0/Z51.1- first.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: Present on admission indicator: inpatient institutional claims only

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section AppI
sources.title: Appendix I

rules.rule: The POA indicator is assigned to diagnoses on inpatient claims (UB-04 / 837 Institutional) subject to POA reporting. It is not reported on outpatient or professional (837P / CMS-1500) claims.
rules.check: Do not send POA on 837P; require it only on inpatient 837I.

implemented.note: The app builds 837P only; no POA is sent.

rules.severity_basis: guidance

rules.title: Severe sepsis R65.2- is never first-listed; the systemic infection comes first

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.1.d.1.a
sources.title: (a) Sepsis

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.1.d.2
sources.title: 2) Septic shock

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.1.d.3
sources.title: 3) Sequencing of severe sepsis

sources.citation: Definitions of Medicare Code Edits v44.0, edit 9
sources.title: Unacceptable principal diagnosis

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Tabular List FY2027, "codeFirst" instructional notes

rules.rule: Code the underlying systemic infection first; R65.2- (severe sepsis, with or without septic shock) can never be the principal diagnosis and is assigned only when severe sepsis or an associated acute organ dysfunction is documented.
rules.check: Error when dx.first starts with R65.2; warn when R65.2- has no infection code before it.

rules.hint: Error in ClaimScrubber when dx.first starts with R65.2 (MCE unacceptable principal list).

rules.title: Current malignancy versus personal history (Z85)

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.2.m
sources.title: m. Current malignancy versus personal history of malignancy

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.2.d
sources.title: d. Primary malignancy previously excised

rules.rule: Use the malignancy code while treatment is directed at the site; use Z85 when the malignancy was excised or eradicated, no further treatment is directed to the site and there is no evidence of disease.
rules.check: Warn when a C code and the Z85 code for the same site are both present.

implemented.note: Warning when a C code (not C77-C79) matches the site of a Z85 code; the site comes from the Index entries History, personal, malignant neoplasm.

rules.hint: Warn when C-code and Z85 code of the same site are both present.
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: Neoplasm symptoms do not replace the malignancy as first-listed

sources.citation: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines FY2027, Section I.C.2.g
sources.title: g. Symptoms, signs, and abnormal findings listed in Chapter 18 associated with neoplasms

sources.citation: Medicare NCCI Policy Manual 2026, Chapter I, Section A

sources.title: Medical/Surgical Package

rules.rule: When the same provider reports two codes of an NCCI PTP pair for the same beneficiary and date of service, the column two code is denied unless the edit allows an NCCI PTP-associated modifier and the clinical circumstances justify it. Component services integral to a comprehensive service are not reported separately.
rules.check: Look up each ordered pair in the PTP table; deny column two unless modifier indicator 1 and an associated modifier is present.

implemented.note: ClaimScrubber.ptpIssues checks every line pair when ReferenceData.ptp is set, but the table is not bundled because CMS serves it behind the AMA CPT license click-through.

rules.title: Mutually exclusive procedures

sources.citation: Medicare NCCI Policy Manual 2026, Chapter I, Section P
sources.title: Mutually Exclusive Procedures

rules.rule: Procedures that cannot reasonably be performed at the same anatomic site or encounter (for example two methods of the same repair, or "initial" and "subsequent" versions) are PTP pairs and are not paid together.
rules.check: Same PTP table lookup.

implemented.note: Covered by ClaimScrubber.ptpIssues when the PTP table is available (not bundled).

rules.hint: Same as NCCI-PTP-01.

rules.title: Only NCCI PTP-associated modifiers bypass a PTP edit, and only when the indicator allows

sources.citation: Medicare NCCI Policy Manual 2026, Chapter I, Section E
sources.title: Modifiers and Modifier Indicators

rules.rule: PTP-associated modifiers: anatomic (E1-E4, FA, F1-F9, TA, T1-T9, LT, RT, LC, LD, RC, LM, RI), global surgery (24, 25, 57, 58, 78, 79) and others (27, 59, 91, XE, XS, XP, XU). Modifier indicator 0 = no bypass; 1 = bypass allowed when clinically justified; 9 = not applicable. Modifiers 22, 76 and 77 do not bypass a PTP edit. A modifier is never added only to bypass an edit.
rules.check: When a PTP pair exists, accept the column two line only if indicator = 1 and one of the listed modifiers is present.

implemented.note: ClaimScrubber.ncciModifiers; modifier indicator 0 never bypasses, 1 needs one of the listed modifiers. Applies when the PTP table is available.

rules.hint: Put the modifier list in a Dart const next to Ptp.modifierAllowed.
rules.severity_basis: claim edit rejection or denial expected

rules.title: Modifier 59 and X{EPSU}: separate encounter, structure, practitioner or non-overlapping service

sources.citation: Medicare NCCI Policy Manual 2026, Chapter I, Section E
sources.title: Modifiers and Modifier Indicators

rules.rule: Modifier 59 is used only when no more descriptive modifier applies; XE, XS, XP, XU are preferred where they fit. It is not appended to E/M services (use 25). Different diagnoses alone do not justify 59/XS; the procedures must be at different anatomic sites or separate encounters. Not used with 77427.
rules.check: Error on 59/X modifiers on an E/M code; warn on 59 when an X modifier fits.

implemented.note: Error on 59/XE/XS/XP/XU on an E/M code and on 59 with 77427; warning on 59 without an X modifier.

rules.hint: Add modifier validation per line in ClaimScrubber using emSettingOf().
rules.severity_basis: coding-guideline violation or payer-specific edit; review

rules.title: E/M on the day of a minor procedure (global 000/010) needs modifier 25 and a separate service

sources.citation: Medicare NCCI Policy Manual 2026, Chapter I, Section D
sources.title: Evaluation & Management (E&M) Services

sources.citation: Medicare NCCI Policy Manual 2026, Chapter I, Section E
sources.title: Modifiers and Modifier Indicators

rules.rule: E/M services on the same day as a minor surgical procedure (global 000 or 010) are included, including the decision to perform it, unless a significant, separately identifiable E/M service is performed, reported with modifier 25. Different diagnoses are not required. Being a new patient alone does not justify it.
rules.check: When an E/M line and a procedure with global 000/010 share the DOS, require modifier 25 on the E/M and documentation of the separate service.

implemented.note: Error when an E/M without modifier 25 is billed with a 000/010 global procedure. The coder does not add 25 itself: the physician decides whether the E/M was separately identifiable.

rules.hint: FeeSchedule.lookup(code).globalDays is already loaded; add the check in ClaimScrubber and default modifier 25 in ClinicalCoder when a separate E/M is documented.

sources.title: Evaluation & Management (E&M) Services

rules.rule: For a major procedure (global 090), an E/M on the same day to decide to perform the surgery is separately reportable with modifier 57; other preoperative E/M services that day are included. MACs, not NCCI, edit this.

sources.citation: Medicare NCCI Policy Manual 2026, Chapter I, Section W
sources.title: Add-on Code Edits

rules.rule: An add-on code is reported only with its primary procedure. Type 1: only the listed primary codes; Type 2: the MAC defines primaries; Type 3: listed primaries plus MAC-defined. If the primary is denied, the add-on is not paid.

rules.rule: For MAI 2 (policy) and MAI 3 (clinical) edits, units for the same code on all lines for the date of service are summed and compared with the MUE; all units are denied if exceeded. MAI 2 denials cannot be overridden on appeal.
